description: This file appears to be a PHP script used for checking user credentials, managing sessions, handling user login and access control, including MSP and customer administrator accounts, and integrating with a web UI for network device management. It includes logic for session creation, IP validation, and various security features related to login attempts and account lockout.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Initializes a user session while performing IP binding for device security and setting session parameters including timeout and user information.

methods.name: innerIP
methods.description: Checks if the client IP is within the internal LAN subnet, used for IP validation and access control.

methods.name: get_ips
methods.description: Retrieves IP addresses associated with a specified network interface.

methods.name: checkCusadminAccess
methods.description: Determines whether a remote IP address has remote management access based on device settings and current operational mode.

methods.name: if_type
methods.description: Classifies an IP address as 'lan_ip', 'cm_ip', or 'rg_ip' based on network scope.

methods.name: getAuthenticationUrl
methods.description: Constructs OAuth authentication URL for SSO login flow.
